sentences.text: Mr. M. G. Patil, App for the Respondent - State.

Coram : N. J. Jamadar, J.
 Date : 5th October, 2023.

PC.:
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 71 of 2023 registered with Sindhudurg Nagari Police Station, Sindhudurg for the offences punishable under Section 327 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. In identical matters, this Court has granted interim relief and posted the matters for consideration on 31st October 2023 as the question of applicability of Section 328 of the Penal Code in a case of the present nature awaits decision of the Supreme Court.

opennyai_summary.decision:
2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 71 of 2023 registered with Sindhudurg Nagari Police Station, Sindhudurg for the offences punishable under Section 327 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. In identical matters, this Court has granted interim relief and posted the matters for consideration on 31st October 2023 as the question of applicability of Section 328 of the Penal Code in a case of the present nature awaits decision of the Supreme Court.

5. The applicant shall co-operate with the investigation and report to the Investigating Offcer as and when directed.
6. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to the frst informant and any person acquainted with the facts of the case.
